knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(raster)
library(here)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
nutri_results<-read.csv(here("output_data/Results/Nutrient_results.csv"))

```

# Residential

```{r}
residential_N<-nutri_results %>% 
  filter(Type %in% c("Connected", "Septic", "Direct", "Coastal_septic", "Coastal_direct"),
         Nutrient == "N") 
```

```{r}
residential_P<-nutri_results %>% 
  filter(Type %in% c("Connected", "Septic", "Direct", "Coastal_septic", "Coastal_direct"),
         Nutrient == "P") 
```

## Total excreted

```{r}
n_excrete<-sum(residential_N$Excreted, na.rm = T)
p_excrete<-sum(residential_P$Excreted, na.rm = T)

n_excrete
p_excrete

```

## Total effluent

```{r}
n_effluent<-sum(residential_N$Effluent, na.rm = T)
p_effluent<-sum(residential_P$Effluent, na.rm = T)

n_effluent
p_effluent
```

## Connected

```{r}
conn_N_eff <- residential_N %>% 
  filter(Type == "Connected")%>% 
  dplyr::select("Effluent") %>% 
  unique()

conn_P_eff <- residential_P %>% 
  filter(Type == "Connected") %>% 
  dplyr::select("Effluent") %>% 
  unique()

```

Percent of effluent that is from WWTP

```{r}
conn_N_eff/n_effluent
conn_P_eff/p_effluent
```

```{r}
conn_N_ex <- residential_N %>% 
  filter(Type == "Connected")%>% 
  dplyr::select("Excreted") %>% 
  unique()

conn_P_ex <- residential_P %>% 
  filter(Type == "Connected") %>% 
  dplyr::select("Excreted") %>% 
  unique

conn_N_ex
conn_P_ex
```

```{r}
conn_N_eff
conn_P_eff
```

```{r}
conn_N_eff/conn_N_ex
conn_P_eff/conn_P_ex
```
Correlation/validation with WWTP values


```{r}
wwtp_compare<-read.csv(here("output_data/Sensitivity/WWTP_compare_nutrients.csv"))

```


```{r}
cor.test(wwtp_compare$N_final*0.001, wwtp_compare$N_eff_actual, method = "pearson")
cor.test(wwtp_compare$P_final*0.001, wwtp_compare$P_eff_actual, method = "pearson")
```

 # Tourism
 
```{r}
t<-c("Tourism_primary", "Tourism_secondary", "Tourism_septic")

tourist<-nutri_results %>% 
  filter(Type %in% t)

tourist_n<-tourist %>% 
  filter(Nutrient == "N")

tourist_p<-tourist %>% 
  filter(Nutrient == "P")
```
 

```{r}
tourist_n_ex<-tourist_n %>% 
  dplyr::select(Excreted) %>% 
  sum()

tourist_p_ex<-tourist_p %>% 
  dplyr::select(Excreted) %>% 
  sum()

tourist_n_ex
tourist_p_ex

```

```{r}
tourist_n_eff<-tourist_n %>% 
  dplyr::select(Effluent) %>% 
  sum()

tourist_p_eff<-tourist_p %>% 
  dplyr::select(Effluent) %>% 
  sum()

tourist_n_eff
tourist_p_eff

```

```{r}
tourist_n_eff/n_effluent
tourist_p_eff/p_effluent
```

```{r}
tourist
```

```{r}
tourist_df<-read.csv(here("output_data/Tourism/Treated_tourist_nutrients.csv")) %>% 
  group_by(Area.1) %>% 
  summarise(Treated_N = sum(Treated_N, na.rm = T),
            Treated_P = sum(Treated_P, na.rm = T))
```

```{r}
(7763.5279+7680.8815+5592.0746)/sum(tourist_df$Treated_N)
```
